title: Silent Hill: Townfall promises a terrifying experience that will subvert expectations of the saga
summary: The new title of the franchise takes place in a remote Scottish town in the internet age and addresses topics such as the healthcare system, while Konami reaffirms its commitment to the series.

title: Double Fine lays off 25% of its staff after becoming independent from Xbox
summary: The studio responsible for Psychonauts 2 cut 23 jobs after separating from Microsoft, affecting key employees of the company.

title: Capcom reports an 81% increase in profits and suggests that a Pragmata sequel is very likely
summary: The sales success of Pragmata and Resident Evil Requiem boosts the company's financial results, whose executives already speak openly about continuing the franchise.

title: Halo: Campaign Evolved performs better on PS5 than on Xbox, reigniting the console war
summary: Xbox's flagship title comes to PlayStation 5 with superior performance, especially on PS5 Pro, while players discover hidden features and mod support on PC.

title: Wuchang: Fallen Feathers will have a sequel directed by its original creator at a new studio
summary: Despite the dissolution of the original team, the creative director confirms a continuation of this soulslike under the name of his new studio, Indolphinity.

title: Krafton turns Subnautica into a main franchise after the overwhelming success of Subnautica 2
summary: After selling 5 million copies in 22 days, Subnautica 2 drives Krafton's record results, which plans to expand the IP beyond its original fan base.

title: The director of Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 criticizes the end of physical discs and announces work on a Switch 2 version
summary: The developers of the promising RPG describe Sony's decision to eliminate discs as 'sad', while stating that porting the game to Switch 2 is a great technical challenge.

title: Pokémon Pokopia premieres its first DLC 'Bubbly Basin' next week with new aquatic content
summary: The expansion arrives on August 5 with update 2.0.0, adding new Pokémon, an underwater area and free content, in addition to confirming its date on Switch 2.

title: Rockstar blocks access to the GTA Online casino in Australia due to gambling restrictions
summary: Australian players can no longer access the Diamond Casino of GTA V's multiplayer due to the country's strict online gambling laws.

title: Marvel launches Spider-Man: Brand New Day with cross-promotion between film and video games
summary: The fight scenes of the new film were directly inspired by screenshots of Marvel's Spider-Man, in a marketing strategy that unites both media.

title: BioWare cannot remaster the Dragon Age trilogy due to lack of technical knowledge of the original engine
summary: No current BioWare employee knows how the graphics engine of the early games works, making a remaster unviable despite general interest.

title: The president of Wizards of the Coast resigns after only two years in office
summary: The top executive of the company behind Dungeons & Dragons and Magic: The Gathering leaves his position after a brief tenure.

title: PlayStation Plus announces the free games for August 2026
summary: Sony has revealed the list of titles that subscribers of the service will be able to download at no additional cost during the next month.

title: Crazy Taxi: World Tour announces competitive multiplayer and a closed network test
summary: The reboot of the saga will include an online multiplayer mode and players will be able to try it soon in a closed beta before its official launch.

title: EA CEO's bonus increases to $38 million while the company lays off developers
summary: Andrew Wilson received an $8 million increase in his annual bonus after the success of Battlefield 6, despite the massive layoffs at the studio responsible for the game.

title: Valve updates the status of Steam Machines with new design blueprints and improvements to the reservation queue
summary: The company publishes the CAD files of the console's exterior and assures that the reservation queue will be up to date by the end of 2026, exceeding initial expectations.

title: Ex-developers of Mass Effect and Dragon Age announce the supernatural detective game The Eventide
summary: The studio Reset, formed by BioWare veterans, presents a neonoir mystery adventure with deduction mechanics in the style of The Case of the Golden Idol.

title: Xbox revenue drops $1.7 billion and Microsoft's discourse on the brand changes drastically
summary: Despite a historic quarter for Microsoft overall, the video game business remains stagnant and its CEO adopts a different discourse than the previous year.

title: GTA 6 fans are convinced that trailer 3 is about to arrive after more than a year of waiting
summary: New rumors and clues suggest that Rockstar could soon show the next trailer of its anticipated sandbox, rekindling the excitement of the community.

title: A police error when reading a Skyrim username sends an innocent person to prison for 18 months
summary: The authorities misinterpreted a man's gamertag, mistaking it for incriminating evidence, resulting in an unjust imprisonment that lasted more than a year.

title: The stylish action RPG Stupid Never Dies announces its launch for October 21
summary: The game presents a new trailer showing its fast-paced combat and confirms the date it will be available on all platforms.

title: WoW Classic Hardcore players are terrorized by hidden underground enemies due to a bug
summary: A bug programmed decades ago is causing enemies to appear underground in the Silithus area, killing max-level characters in permadeath mode.

title: The director of Final Fantasy 7 Revelation plans a cross-raids with Final Fantasy 14
summary: Naoki Yoshida and the team design a special encounter with a mysterious boss for the upcoming crossover event between both titles.

title: The Sinking City 2 shows 12 minutes of gameplay with Lovecraftian aberrations and psychological horror
summary: The anticipated title from Frogwares presents a new and extensive gameplay trailer that immerses players in a world of cosmic horrors.

title: Nexus Mods seeks to simplify mod installation with a single click
summary: The world's largest modding platform plans to eliminate player frustration by making it easier to manage and apply modifications in games.
